title: Adaptive audit export snapshots and shared saved-query workflow
creator: Riley Chen
description: Implement an adaptive sampling export mode for the Audit Console that produces deterministic, shareable snapshot exports (CSV/JSON) for high-volume log ranges, plus a lightweight saved-query sharing workflow. Goals: (1) let admins generate representative snapshots when full export would be prohibitively large; (2) preserve filter semantics, time-bounds, and role-aware redaction; (3) support sharing a saved-query + snapshot link that other users can re-run (subject to RBAC); (4) allow fallthrough to full export jobs for retained historical exports.
acceptance_criteria: UI: Export modal shows option 'Representative snapshot (adaptive sampling)' with configurable target rows and deterministic seed
Backend: Snapshot generation supports CSV and newline-delimited JSON, preserves applied filters and sort order, and applies role-aware redaction rules based on requesting user
Determinism: Re-running a saved-query with the same time bounds and seed returns the same snapshot ordering within 0.1% of rows for stable time windows
Saved queries: Users can save a query with metadata (name, description, visibility: private/team/org) and share a URL that opens the console with query preloaded and snapshot-ready

Export scale: Snapshot generation completes for a 7-day, high-volume workspace (1B events) by sampling upstream partitions and finishes within 20 minutes for 1M target rows; full-stream export falls back to async job with cursored pagination
Security: Only users with 'audit.read' can export; only 'admin' or 'security' roles can export unredacted fields. Audit of export actions must itself be emitted as an export-event log entry
Observability: Export jobs surface progress in Console jobs panel with tokenized throughput and bytes written; failures return actionable errors (quota, retention, role-blocked, storage issues)

comments: 2025-03-01 Riley Chen: Ticket created after spike showing naive full-stream export is infeasible for SOC customers. Proposed adaptive sampling to reduce export size while keeping forensic value.

2025-03-04 Asha Patel: Prototype of deterministic sampler implemented using reservoir sample per partition; measured 2.4x reduction in rows for equivalent attribute coverage on sample dataset. Need to validate across skewed workloads.
2025-03-06 Miguel Torres: Security review notes - redaction must be applied server-side before sampling to avoid leaking sensitive tokens in sample selection. Blocking until design updated.
2025-03-08 Riley Chen: Updated design to apply redaction in the ingestion read path before reservoir selection. Added integration tests for PII fields.

2025-03-10 Asha Patel: Performance test (r5.16xlarge) - snapshot generator achieved 110k rows/sec sustained for 1M target rows; CPU-bound on parser stage. Plan: move CSV emit to streaming writer and parallelize partition reads.
2025-03-12 Jordan Brooks: PM review - agreed on saved-query visibility model. UX request: include a quick-preview sample (100 rows) inline before committing a snapshot export.
2025-03-12 Riley Chen: Blocking dependency ENG-82419 for deterministic cursor API; asked infra for ETA. Also linked ENG-43210 for role-aware export redaction precedent.
